name: Devout
prompt:
Draw one icon in pure white flat ink (#FFFFFF) on a fully transparent background, in exactly the style of the attached
reference icons (the Wick trait and perk icons: bold flat white shapes, a confident inked silhouette with a few
interior cuts, the same line weight). No outline in another colour, no shading, no gradient, no texture, no glow, no
colour and no grey. This icon is an object or a sign, not a figure: do not draw Wick or any person unless the line below
says so. One subject, centred, with clear space around it, square, 1024 x 1024 PNG with transparency. It must read at
24 px in a row and look right at 56 px on a dark disc: silhouette first, two or three interior cuts at most. No text, no
letters, no numbers, no border, no frame. Invented shapes only: nothing recognisable from real-world works, brands or
insignia (a medical mark is a plain plus, never a red cross).


Paint this ONE subject:
A votive candle on a short stand with one tall flame and a thin standing stone behind it. (Devotion XP after each fight.)
Pure-white filled shapes with transparent interior cuts; confident substantial ink weight matching reference nonfigure shop sign. No mascot, no Wick. Keep all detail sturdy at 24 pixels. Transparent margin 10–15% all around. Not a thin wireframe.
CRITICAL SILHOUETTE: The foreground is a clearly recognizable squat votive candle on a short dish stand, with one tall flame. Behind it an offset taller RECTANGULAR STANDING STONE, blunt square top. Keep the entire candle, flame and stand separated from the slab by a wide fully TRANSPARENT negative-space gap or transparent cutout. Use pure white ink shapes only; every interior line and separation is a TRUE TRANSPARENT cut. Never use offwhite or pale-gray interior marks on an opaque white shape: they disappear in a white UI mask. No textured stone or gray shading. Candle flame must remain visibly its own teardrop at 24px. Show candle plus standing stone, no people or mascot.
export_processing: Alpha-bounds crop and aspect-preserving fit inside central 820px of 1024px canvas; Lanczos UI exports; pure-white RGB enforced preserving generated alpha
